Teachers

Help learners discover their teachers, explore courses they teach and get in touch without maintaining a separate staff directory.

Teachers automatically builds a searchable directory from existing Moodle users, direct course-level role assignments and course information.

What the plugin offers
  • Searchable and paginated teacher cards with profile pictures.
  • Teacher biographies, optional graduation details and LinkedIn links.
  • Visible course listings with images and descriptions.
  • Configurable teacher roles, guest access and private messaging.
  • Administrative exclusions that do not affect enrolments or roles.
  • Responsive Mustache templates and English / Brazilian Portuguese strings.
Automatically up to date
Teachers are discovered from qualifying direct course-role assignments, so there is no separate roster or scheduled synchronization job.
Profiles connected to courses
Teacher pages show native profile information and the visible courses they teach, with normal Moodle access rules still applying to course links.
Controlled visibility
Administrators choose teacher roles, can exclude individuals and decide whether visitors may see the directory.
Installation and configuration

Install the plugin in local/teacher and open Site administration > Plugins > Local plugins > Teachers. Choose the course-level roles that identify teachers, configure guest access and enable or disable teacher contact.

The directory appears at /local/teacher/. Teacher profiles use Moodle account photographs and descriptions; optional graduation and LinkedIn information comes from Moodle custom user profile fields.

Privacy and permissions

Anonymous visitors can see teacher information only if public access is enabled. When public access is allowed, names, photographs, biographies, public curriculum fields and visible course information may be exposed; review institutional privacy requirements before enabling this setting.

Private messages use Moodle messaging permissions, blocking rules and session protection. The plugin stores only administrator-managed directory exclusions in its own table and integrates with Moodle privacy exports and deletion requests.
